name: 18V brushless cordless drill
description: Two-speed brushless drill with two 2.0Ah batteries, charger and a 40-piece bit set. Used it for decking, shelf brackets and flat-pack furniture; the chuck holds bits tight. Comes in the original hard case.

name: 20V hammer drill and masonry bits
description: Hammer mode makes short work of brick and concrete; drill mode handles timber and metal. Includes two 4.0Ah batteries, a fast charger and a 12-piece masonry bit set. Only used for one bathroom refit.

name: Impact driver with 60-piece bit set
description: Drives long screws and lag bolts without stripping heads. 1/4-inch hex quick-release, two batteries, belt hook and a 60-piece driver set. Handy for fences, garden furniture and decking.

name: 7¼-inch circular saw, corded
description: 1500W circular saw with a fresh 24-tooth blade for ripping timber and sheet goods. Cuts 65mm at 90 degrees. The base plate is slightly scuffed but the shoe still runs square to the blade.

name: Variable-speed jigsaw with blades
description: Cuts curves in plywood, worktops and plastic with the orbital action switched on. Includes 10 assorted blades and a dust port. The plastic base has a crack near the front but it does not affect the cut.

name: 4½-inch angle grinder
description: 900W angle grinder for cutting rebar, grinding welds and stripping paint. Takes 115mm discs. Two guards and a side handle included. The spindle lock sticks a little — hold the disc still when changing it.

name: Random orbital sander, 125mm
description: Smooths filler, paint edges and bare timber quickly. Dust bag and a stack of 80/120/240 discs included. Velcro pad still grabs well. Ideal before varnishing a table or sanding a door frame.

name: Corded reciprocating saw
description: Demolition saw for pruning thick branches, cutting pipe and breaking down pallets. Takes standard reciprocating blades. Includes six wood and metal blades. Loud, so bring ear defenders.

name: Brad nailer and small compressor
description: 18-gauge brad nailer with a 6-litre compressor and 10m hose. Perfect for skirting, architraves and trim without filling hammer marks. Compressor is oil-free and quiet enough for a flat.

name: 2000W heat gun with nozzles
description: Strips paint and varnish, loosens stubborn nuts and shrinks heat-shrink tubing. Two temperature settings with four nozzles. The cable is 3m — you will still want an extension lead outside.

name: Plunge router with 12 bits
description: 1400W plunge router for grooves, rebates, hinge recesses and roundovers. Includes 12 router bits, guide fence and dust extraction port. Depth stop works smoothly; the fine adjuster needs a firm turn.

name: Rotary multi-tool kit
description: Corded rotary tool for detail sanding, cutting and polishing in tight spots. Comes with 40 accessories and a flexible shaft. Great for model work, trimming plastic and cleaning grout.

name: 6-inch bench grinder
description: Two-wheel bench grinder for sharpening chisels, axes and drill bits. One coarse and one fine wheel, plus eye shields. Bolts onto a bench; the left wheel is a little out of round but usable.

name: 10-inch sliding mitre saw
description: Sliding compound mitre saw for skirting, studwork and decking with accurate 45-degree cuts. Laser guide works. Includes a 60-tooth blade and material clamp. Heavy — bring a friend to move it.

name: 94-piece socket and spanner set
description: Chrome vanadium socket set covering 4–32mm with ratchets, extensions and combination spanners. Everything is present and sorted in the case. Ideal for car jobs, bikes and flat-pack assembly.

name: Adjustable spanner set, 3 sizes
description: Three adjustable spanners (150mm, 200mm, 250mm) for plumbing, car repairs and anything without a fixed size. Jaws move freely and grip well. A trace of surface rust on the smallest one.

name: Precision screwdriver set, 60 bits
description: Magnetic precision driver with 60 bits for phones, laptops, glasses and small appliances. Includes Torx, tri-wing and pentalobe. The case hinge is fine; one bit is slightly rounded.

name: 16oz fibreglass claw hammer
description: General-purpose claw hammer for driving nails and pulling them out. Fibreglass handle absorbs shock. The face has a few dings from years of shed projects but the grip is solid.

name: Heavy-duty hacksaw with blades
description: Cuts metal pipe, threaded rod and angle iron. Includes ten 24-TPI blades and a spare frame. Blade tensioner holds well. Best used with a drop of oil on the cut.

name: 14-inch pipe wrench
description: Heavy cast pipe wrench for loosening old plumbing unions and galvanised pipe. Jaws bite hard. The handle has been taped where the original grip wore through — cosmetic only.

name: 1/2-inch torque wrench, 40–210Nm
description: Calibrated click-type torque wrench for wheel nuts, cylinder heads and suspension bolts. Comes with a 1/2-inch to 3/8-inch adapter and a hard case. Last calibrated about a year ago.

name: Pliers and cutters set, 5-piece
description: Long-nose, combination, side-cutting, water-pump and wire-stripping pliers. Insulated handles. The side cutters still slice copper wire cleanly; the spring on the long-nose pair is a bit soft.

name: Wood chisel set, 6-piece
description: Bevel-edge chisels from 6mm to 38mm for hinge mortises, cleaning joints and paring. Honed and ready to cut. Includes a honing guide. Please do not use them on screws or nails.

name: 1200mm spirit level
description: Box-section aluminium level with three vials (horizontal, vertical and 45 degrees). Accurate enough for hanging doors, tiling and shelving. One end cap is missing, so treat the last centimetre as rough.

name: 8m steel tape measure
description: 8-metre auto-lock tape with a magnetic hook and clear metric and imperial markings. The lock holds firmly and the blade retracts smoothly. A budget favourite for measuring rooms and timber.

name: Rolling tool chest with tools
description: Seven-drawer rolling chest on castors, stocked with screwdrivers, pliers, a hammer, a level and assorted spanners. Everything in the photos is included. The top drawer lock is stiff but works.
